name: Barbell Narrow-Stance Squat
steps: Rest a barbell securely across your upper traps and stand with your feet closer than shoulder width, toes pointing slightly outward.
Brace your core tightly and keep your chest upright.
Bend your knees and hips smoothly to squat as low as your mobility allows while keeping both heels flat.
Drive firmly through your full feet to extend your legs back to standing.
tips: Track your knees in line with your toes rather than letting them drift inward.
Keep your torso tall and avoid letting your heels lift off the floor at the bottom.
